title: File:Church of St. Andrew, Alfriston, England Crop - May 2009.jpg
claims: The image shows the Church of St Andrew at Alfriston, with a shingled broach spire, flint walls, red tiled roofs, gravestones, a low flint wall and the green Tye in front, under a blue sky with white cloud.

The file title identifies the Church of St Andrew, Alfriston, England, as a May 2009 crop; it contains no SDW100, Centurion Running or race-day context and is a village landmark photograph, not the Old Chapel Centre aid station, runners or race markings.

The author is David Iliff (Diliff); the file is licensed CC BY-SA 3.0; the original crop is 6,233 x 3,561 pixels and 9.29 MB, dated May 2009. The Commons file page is the source of the licence and authorship.
The route page uses a 760 x 434 rendition of 133,044 bytes, without further cropping or colour change; attribution and share-alike are required.
